lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when two independent checks format pre check and digest verification can both reject the same bad input with the same wrapped error code assert on the specific rejection cause message not just the error code so removing either check is independently detected
lessons.text: When two independent checks (format pre-check and digest verification) can both reject the same bad input with the same wrapped error code, assert on the specific rejection cause/message, not just the error code, so removing either check is independently detected.
